attchmntText: Rategain Travel Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited has disclosed a schedule for an investor meeting under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The event is the Avendus Spark INDX Investor Conference 2026. It is scheduled for November 17, 2026. The meeting will take place in Mumbai. The mode is a physical meeting. The format includes one-on-one and group meetings. The company refers to publicly available documents for the discussions.

attchmntText: Rategain Travel Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on  Uzbekistan Airways Selects RateGain to Strengthen Pricing Agility AcrossIts Expanding International Network "".
voiceSummary: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited announced that Uzbekistan Airways has selected AirGain, its competitive fare intelligence platform. The partnership aims to strengthen pricing agility across the airline's expanding international network. AirGain will provide real-time visibility of competitor fares to support revenue management decisions. Uzbekistan Airways carried 6.6 million passengers in 2025 and operates a fleet of 47 aircraft. The carrier plans to double its fleet by 2030. RateGain stated that AirGain users have reported up to 80% faster access to insights and a 1.5% increase in direct bookings. This agreement follows a competitive tender process. The announcement was filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Rategain Travel Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited filed a transcript of its earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026, with analysts and institutional investors. The call discussed financial and operational performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company states that participants were briefed on published financial results and the general industry overview. An earnings presentation was referred to during the call. The transcript is available on the company website at https://investors.rategain.com/financial-information/financial-results/. This intimation is submitted in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The filing was signed by Mukesh Kumar, General Counsel, Company Secretary, and Compliance Officer.
